headline: TT&A, Farooq and Associates advise IFC on sanctioning $30 million to Popular Pharma
sum: The International Finance Corporation is set to extend a loan aggregating up to $30.7 million to Popular Pharmaceuticals PLC, a company incorporated in Bangladesh. TT&A advised IFC on this financing transaction.
detail: The International Finance Corporation is set to extend a loan aggregating up to $30.7 million to Popular Pharmaceuticals PLC, a company incorporated in Bangladesh. TT&A advised IFC on this financing transaction. The transaction team consisted of Gautam Saha (Managing Partner), Nikhil Bahl (Partner), Ankita Mandal (Managing Associate) and Manasvini Vyas (Associate). Gautam Saha, Nikhil Bahl TT&A had recently advised IFC on sanctioning loans for Bangladesh-based PRAN-RFL Group companies.
